description_en: Modifies the forwarding mode of an Elastic IP Address (EIP)
kebab_example: aliyun vpc modify-eip-forward-mode --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --instance-id eip-j5ebhbw3br92fy0000 --biz-mode BINDED --client-token 02fb3da4-130e-11e9-8e44-0016e04115b --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyEipForwardMode

parameters.description_en: The region ID of the EIP. You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~25609~~) operation to query region IDs.
parameters.description_zh: EIP所属的地域ID。您可以通过调用DescribeRegions接口获取地域ID。
parameters.help_en: The region ID of the EIP. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25609.html operation to query region IDs

parameters.description_en: The ID of the EIP instance to modify.
parameters.help_en: The ID of the EIP instance to modify
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.description_en:
The binding mode. Valid values:

- **NAT** (default): NAT mode (standard mode).

- **MULTI_BINDED**: multi-EIP to ENI mode.

- **BINDED**: EIP to ENI mode.


> This parameter is required only when **InstanceType** is set to **NetworkInterface**.
parameters.description_zh:
绑定模式，取值：

- **NAT**（默认值）：NAT模式（普通模式）。

- **MULTI_BINDED**：多EIP网卡可见模式。

- **BINDED**：EIP网卡可见模式。


> 仅**InstanceType**配置为**NetworkInterface**时，才需要配置该参数。
